biotools.summary: GPCRact is a structure-aware graph neural network framework that predicts ligand-induced GPCR activity by modeling allosteric communication from heavy-atom coordinates of binding- and allosteric-site residues, underpinned by the GPCRactDB database and benchmarks for structure-guided drug discovery.
